case_title: CRYSTAL FONG VS. LUIS PEREZ et al

docket_entries.description: AUTO ACCIDENT CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $7,500.00 FILED BY FONG, CRYSTAL AS TO DEFENDANT PEREZ, LUIS (REGISTERED OWNER) PEREZ, DIANA (DRIVER) ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR FEB-08-2012 AT 01:30 PM IN DEPT 506
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF (SERVICE FEE $35.00) SERVED JAN-11-2012, SUBSTITUTE SERVICE ON NATURAL PERSON AS TO DEFENDANT PEREZ, LUIS (REGISTERED OWNER)
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF (SERVICE FEE $85.00) SERVED JAN-11-2012, SUBSTITUTE SERVICE ON NATURAL PERSON AS TO DEFENDANT PEREZ, DIANA (DRIVER)

DISMISSED. NO FURTHER ACTION TAKEN BY THE COURT. THIS CASE WAS PREVIOUSLY HEARD BY THIS COURT ON SMALL CLAIMS CASE # CSM-11-838803 ON NOVEMBER 14, 2011. DIANA PEREZ, THE DRIVER APPEARED ON NOVEMBER 14, 2011 AND THE PLAINTIFF APPEARED. THE OWNER, LUIS PEREZ HAD NOT BEEN SERVED AND HIS APPEARANCE WAS WAIVED. JUDGMET FOR THE DEFENDANT WAS ENTERED. APPEARANCE BY PLAINTIFF. APPEARANCE BY DEFENDANT DIANA PEREZ. JUDGE: LYNN O'MALLEY TAYLOR. CLERK: S. VANTREE. NOT REPORTED. (506)
